The implementation comprises `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/buzz_bindings.py` (optional `agent_bindings` key in `buzz.json` mapping a Buzz agent id/display name to an F013 worker-profile id — fail-soft loading, off by default, display-only join that dispatch never consults), the `dontpanic workers buzz-bindings [--project] [--json]` status surface in `workers_cli.py`, and doc coverage in `docs/GETTING_STARTED.md` and `docs/AGENT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` stating Buzz stays the membership UX, DontPanic stays the dispatch authority, and any Buzz-initiated run requires the F007 confirm-gated caller. Verification: all 22 F016 tests pass (including the profile-id-collision and unbound authority-invariant regressions from earlier audit findings), ruff check and format-check are clean on the three F016 files, and a live CLI smoke confirmed both acceptance behaviors — empty config prints "(none configured — feature off by default)" and a configured map renders `Fizz -> fizz (Fizz)  harness=claude, model=claude-fable-5` while an unbound `Ghost -> nobody` row shows UNBOUND with an operator-fixable message and gains no dispatch. No code changes were needed this iteration.
